title: CodeGraph status reports a large index, but the CLI/API context query returned unrelated symbols from another repository
facts: CodeGraph status reports a large index, but the CLI/API context query returned unrelated symbols from another repository (creatorhub XhsApiClient). The graph context is not valid evidence for this repository flow and will not be used for claims; direct current-source tracing is required.
evidence: codegraph_context for ai-distill returned creatorhub/app/platforms/xhs/client.py as its entry point alongside ai-distill symbols.
impact: The graph index appears cross-project or contaminated for context lookup; index size alone does not establish current-repository coverage.

updates.action: 为当前 Trace 查看器补齐其要求的记录字段；保留原事实、证据和范围边界。当前只读/修改范围按本轮明确allowlist执行。历史事件本身不撤销。
Use current workspace rg/sed/source and route registration, not CodeGraph context, for this audit.
